_meta.description: Seed customer cases for the Prospects view. Each case is a full engine input set. Yong Wen / Venus are documented reconstructions (assumptions), not confirmed customer figures.

cases.name: Evergreen Logistics (illustrative, fully specified)
cases.note: ILLUSTRATIVE assumption case, NOT a real customer. Every input is a realistic Singapore-market figure chosen so the model passes all gates: vehicle service/evidence 'Within entered limits', charging-site 'Complete' with an itemised depot quote, 'Within entered site limits', a numeric Total economic TCO and a positive Saving vs Keep ICE. It shows what a confirmed-win prospect looks like once the charging-site quote and verification evidence are supplied, in contrast to the reconstruction cases below that stay diagnostic-only pending their site quotes.
